# AgentReady Index

> Preliminary 0-100 scores for how well 21 online stores and platforms let AI agents shop, book and get service. Built by Kevin Harmon. Last updated 2026-10-18. Open data, CC BY 4.0. Agents and crawlers are welcome.

## Data
- [sites.json](https://kah6314.github.io/agentready-index/data/sites.json): all stores; fields id, name, category, url, date, status, subscores (bot_access/20, agent_checkout/20, structured_paths/20, email/10, sms/10, live_chat/10, book_online/10), total/100, evidence[], notes
- Per-store JSON: https://kah6314.github.io/agentready-index/data/sites/<id>.json
- [evidence.csv](https://kah6314.github.io/agentready-index/data/evidence.csv): raw crawl results
- [changelog.json](https://kah6314.github.io/agentready-index/data/changelog.json)

## Pages
- [Methodology](https://kah6314.github.io/agentready-index/methodology.html)
- [Launch post: We tested 21 stores to see which let AI agents shop](https://kah6314.github.io/agentready-index/launch.html)
- [About](https://kah6314.github.io/agentready-index/about.html)

# Methodology
Scores 0-100: bot_access/20 (bot-UA crawl: home status, robots.txt, GPTBot/ClaudeBot disallows), agent_checkout/20, structured_paths/20 (API, MCP, agent payments), email/10, sms/10, live_chat/10, book_online/10. Dimensions 2-7 from public documentation. Preliminary; no live checkout tests yet. Cite as: AgentReady Index, Kevin Harmon, https://kah6314.github.io/agentready-index

# Store details

## Allbirds - 86/100 (rank #1 of 21, Retail (Shopify))
URL: https://kah6314.github.io/agentready-index/stores/allbirds.html
Scored: 2026-10-18 (preliminary)
Subscores: Bot access 19/20, Agent checkout 15/20, Structured/API/MCP 15/20, Email 9/10, Text/SMS 9/10, Live chat 9/10, Book online/text 10/10
Summary: Shopify storefront: home and robots reachable; robots.txt restricts some crawler paths. Shopify merchants get Shopify UCP agentic checkout by platform default (https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/storefront-mcp); score assumes the platform defaults are enabled. Oct 13 update: contact/booking channels re-scored from official help pages (see evidence); browser checkout tests not yet run. Oct 18 crawl: home page returned HTTP 429 ("local_rate_limited") to the AgentReady bot UA and to a GPTBot UA, including a retry after the 60-second Retry-After window, while a browser UA got the full page; robots.txt unchanged. Bot access held pending a retest from a second network.
Evidence:
- Crawl 2026-10-18 (weekly update): home HTTP 429 (18 bytes), robots HTTP 200, GPTBot/ClaudeBot full disallows 0: https://kah6314.github.io/agentready-index/data/evidence.csv
- robots.txt (saved copy): https://kah6314.github.io/agentready-index/data/raw/robots_allbirds.txt
- Live robots.txt: https://www.allbirds.com/robots.txt
- Shopify agentic commerce docs: https://shopify.dev/docs/agents
- Shopify UCP agentic checkout: https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/storefront-mcp
- email: yes - help@allbirds.com listed for orders, returns, account: https://www.allbirds.com/pages/contact-us
